svg.title: AFTERLIGHT: the city as a directed road graph
svg.desc: Actual canonical layout: 201 nodes, 233 physical roads, 586 directed edges and 1,240 permitted edge transitions. The 24-edge recorded Cross-city route runs from curb pickup P001 to Eastbank General. Both hospitals and all graph nodes are shown. Opposing edges overlap in the city overview; an enlarged H00 corridor shows its four nodes, three segments and six directed edges. Pickup anchors attach to edges; they are not graph nodes. Dijkstra minimizes edge length while following permitted turns.
